type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M),
  ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (D E : Divisor M) (RD : PolarPresentation M hDVR D) (RE : PolarPresentation M hDVR E) (f r : ↥M.K),
      r ≠ 0 →
        (∀ (P : Place ↥M.K), D P + E P = poleMultiplicity M hDVR f P + ord M hDVR P r) →
          ∃ C, ∀ (x : QbarPoint ↥M.K), |divHeight RD x + divHeight RE x - functionHeight M f x| ≤ C
